description: Returns a slashtel.com link with the chosen eSIM plan or top-up already selected. Share it with the user: they enter their email and pay on the site. For type 'esim' pass plan_id. For type 'topup' pass phone, operator_code and option_id from get_topup_plans.

language.description: Optional. The sender's language. The top-up link opens the Slashtel page in that language where one exists, otherwise the English page.

option_id.description: Top-up: option_id of the chosen option from get_topup_plans

send_value.description: Deprecated, use option_id. Still accepted for older conversations.

sender_country.description: Optional. ISO-2 country the sender is in, e.g. US, FR, SA. Helps pick the matching page.

name: create_checkout_link
title: Create checkout link
